goal: Initialize the physical repository structure required for Phase 1 persistence and testing under D:/__CoChem by creating the host volume bind anchor __agentic/v2/data/.gitkeep and the test package marker __agentic/v2/tests/__init__.py while ensuring strict zero-write isolation over legacy v1 assets (.scripts/ and cochem_kanban.db).

acceptance_criteria.statement: Physical files __agentic/v2/data/.gitkeep and __agentic/v2/tests/__init__.py exist on disk, are regular files, and are readable, establishing the Docker volume bind target and Python test package structure (AC-10, FR-2.8).
Zero-write isolation over legacy v1 assets is preserved, confirmed by zero git diffs or modifications under .scripts/ and unchanged modification timestamp on cochem_kanban.db (AC-29, INV-4).

test_cases.name: test_directory_scaffold_exists
test_cases.asserts: Verifies that __agentic/v2/data/.gitkeep and __agentic/v2/tests/__init__.py physically exist on disk and can be opened for reading.

test_cases.name: test_v1_isolation_guard
test_cases.asserts: Verifies via git status that .scripts/ has zero tracked or untracked modifications and verifies via filesystem stat that cochem_kanban.db mtime has not been altered.

out_of_scope: Authoring Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, schema_v2.sql, or init_db.py
Modifying any files within .scripts/ or altering cochem_kanban.db
Docker container builds, daemon operations, or external network requests
Runtime worker or orchestrator daemon implementations
risks: Inadvertent write access or timestamp modification to legacy cochem_kanban.db or .scripts/
Missing parent directory structures when creating .gitkeep or __init__.py files
External processes concurrently accessing or updating cochem_kanban.db causing false isolation failures
